fact: The framing report of the 2024 State Budget proposal lists, under the health programme, 'Reforço do SIS - Sistema de Informação Sanitária' - a new version of the integrated health system on the IGRP Web platform and the 'SIS - Processo Clínico Eletrónico' - with 6 million CVE; it does not say whether the money is domestic or donor, and the date is taken from the file name (29 September 2023).
title: Relatório de Enquadramento [Orçamento do Estado 2024]
